data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 0b13382ebfe2 DEPENDS ON SRC_003's mean principle but adds a parity gate the original lacks: it first computes n = S/3 via the mean principle (inheriting SRC_003's mechanism), then applies a parity check on n before proceeding — a gate that fires exactly when S/3 is odd, blocking the derivation before a non-even triple is emitted. The neighbourhood artifacts emit 48 only because 138/3 = 46 is even; 0b13382ebfe2 makes this contingency explicit. REFUTED IF 0b13382ebfe2 does not invoke the mean principle, or if it does not apply a parity check as a gate but only as a post-hoc filter on the output triple.
